bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · testing the 100 and 200-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 考验 100 日和 200 日均线

read.en: Meta fell 1.0% on Oct 23 to $642.62, trading between $633.27 and $648.04. It is below the falling 5-day ($677.7) and 10-day ($707.8) and rising 30-day ($715.4), and above the rising 100-day ($630.8) and 200-day ($632.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and is now below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($747.49), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: Meta 10月23日下跌 1.0%，收于 $642.62，盘中区间 $633.27–648.04。股价位于下行的 5 日（$677.7）和 10 日（$707.8）以及上行的 30 日均线（$715.4）下方，高于上行的 100 日（$630.8）和 200 日均线（$632.5）。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方，现已跌破零轴，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$747.49），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The $633.3 low dipped under the $638.6–639.7 support (Dec 12, 2025 and Oct 22 lows) before the close recovered above it. Resistance is $648 (Oct 23 high), then $677.7–681 (5-day, Oct 22 high) and $690–694. Support is $633–639.7, then $630.8–632.5 (100 and 200-day) and $600 (Jan 20 low). A close below $630 would open $600; a close above $648 would target $678–681.
